'''Orrick Gwyndon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who served as a member of the [[Queensguard]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Orrick Gwyndon allied with [[Samara Organa]], who wanted to discern the truth about the assassination of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Gaul Panteer]] and uncover his murderer. Together, they tasked a Republic ally with recovering the assassination holorecording from the library in the Holo Archives of [[Castle Panteer]].<ref name="Red Handed" /> After uncovering the truth, Orrick and the Queensguard were dispatched by Lady [[Katei Elinari Panteer]] to accompany [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces with the intention of arresting [[Bouris Ulgo]].

==Behind the scenes==
Orrick appears in the mission "Red Handed" for Republic classes in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Red Handed" />
